caseName: Bessemer & Lake Erie Railroad Co. v. Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel Corp.
caseNameFull: Bessemer & Lake Erie Railroad Co. v. Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel Corp. Et Al.

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motions of Association of American Railroads and Business Roundtable for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. The parties are directed to file responses addressing the impact of the settlement on the questions presented by the petition for writ of certiorari within 30 days.
